title: Validation y trazabilidad documental

tests.full_regression_reason: UOC-003 is bounded to a new facade/UI panel/contracts; impacted suites and global validators are mandatory.

preliminary_limits: Validation jobs execute synchronously in this first version.
Cancellation, heartbeat, retry and durable async scheduling are deferred to UOC-007/UOC-008.
Traceability is explicit-only and does not infer semantic relationships.
Artifact profile support reuses current deterministic profiles and may require future domain-specific expansion.
The UI render boundary isolates component failures but does not replace future browser-level telemetry/structured client error reporting.
Findings remain client-side paginated at 25/page; v1.0.4 additionally constrains the visible list height. Server-side pagination/virtualization remains a future scalability option.

browser_contrast_v1_0_2.cause: dark UOC-003 fallback surface inherited global dark text

browser_navigation_v1_0_3.evidence_summary: API returned HTTP 200 for document, metadata, history, diff and links; browser later showed a partial top-of-page render and list filter remained in Consultando without a new list HTTP request.
systemic_correction: transactional fragment render before DOM commit
explicit navigation feedback and automatic target/fallback focus

browser_navigation_dom_v1_0_4.confirmed_root_cause: DocumentViewer called section.insertBefore(notice, content) before content was a child of section; DOM insertion therefore failed whenever section/line focus activated. Path-only navigation skipped the notice/scroll/back branch entirely.
observed_effects: path-only finding navigation loaded the document but did not auto-scroll or expose return action
traceability source navigation with line context raised DOM insertBefore error inside the viewer render boundary
findings screenshot contract could not fit toolbar/cards/pagination in one 1440x900 viewport
traceability is automatically loaded by execute; secondary button styling looked disabled although it was an optional refresh
systemic_correction: append navigation notice only after safe DOM ownership is established
automatic viewer/target scroll and focus for all contextual navigation
origin-aware return action to findings or traceability
bounded-height findings list with pagination always reachable
explicit Recargar trazabilidad semantics after automatic load
